value.rationale: Quadrature-weight sign controls monotonicity and error amplification, and positive-feature truncation makes regularization a natural stability knob. A necessary-and-sufficient all-integer design-uniform threshold with a parity crossover plus unavoidable asymptotic constant-function bias quantifies a structural cost of guaranteeing positivity by nugget inflation. This provides a precise benchmark for contrasting constrained/renormalized quadrature against the unmodified ridge estimator.
